steps.caption: Her role and company at the top. 'Why do we believe this?' shows the evidence.
Plan outreach starts a draft; Enrichment & verification checks her details; Edit changes them.
Employment history: each job with its dates. Past roles are kept, not overwritten.
Relationships: who knows her, how (client of), how warm, and the last contact.
Add relationship context or connect her to another person — this feeds intro paths.
Introduction consent: whether she agreed to introduce you. 'Permission not recorded' means ask first.
Interactions: every meeting, call and email with her, newest first.
Outreach: drafts and approved messages to her, with their status.
Commitments and tasks you promised her — like 'Send 3 options'.
Relationship level: CRE OS suggests one from your history — 'Use suggestion' or pick your own.
Memories: what the assistant remembers about her, which you can review.
Contact details: add only what she shared — never guessed.
Archive needs a reason and goes to Review — nothing is deleted outright.
